report.summary: All 9 hypotheses reviewed: 4 refuted, 3 narrowed, 1 needs-evidence, 1 blocked; detailed verdicts in handoff.
risks: incomplete_cycle_detection: If parse._import_records does not walk function bodies, cycle detection misses runtime cycles.
withheld-leak: If meta fields preserve withheld content, refusal receipts leak sensitive data.
invisible-dependency-interface: Undocumented external dependencies may break silently.
scope-key-mismatch: Resolver from wrong scope causes incorrect resolution.
metric-contract: Inconsistent similarity metric may cause incorrect link resolution.
suffix-match-ambiguity: False positive node matching may corrupt correctness evaluation.
type-resolution-ambiguity: Missing type edges degrade hotspot analysis.
baseline-skip-focus-withheld: Focus-withheld tasks may be exfiltrated despite baseline skip.
todos: Verify parse._import_records with ast.walk to confirm function body imports are captured.
Inspect _refusal_receipt meta handling to ensure no withheld content leaks.
Document all external dependencies and add interface tests for canary, evolution, switches, imports.
Trace scope_key propagation from index.py to all consumers, especially gated_writes.py.
Confirm markdown link resolution never uses embedding similarity, or enforce cosine similarity.
Retrieve full picker.py to count 'nothing was applied' statements.
Check test framework node ID uniqueness to assess suffix collision risk.
Analyze impact of ambiguous dotted name exclusion on picker.py's hotspot_candidates.
Audit all task content transmission paths for focus_withheld checks.

verdicts.strongest_counterargument: parse._import_records uses ast.walk, which recurses into all nodes including function bodies, so function-body imports are included in the index.
verdicts.survives_because: The hypothesis is refuted by the code's use of ast.walk; the evidence provided confirms the index includes function-body imports.
verdicts.settling_check: Inspect parse._import_records to confirm ast.walk is used and function-body imports are captured.

verdicts.strongest_counterargument: _refusal_receipt may explicitly clear all meta fields or withheld content is never stored in meta.
verdicts.survives_because: The code snippet does not show meta handling; without evidence of clearing, the leak possibility remains.
verdicts.narrowed_claim: If meta is preserved and original turn had withheld content in meta, it leaks into refusal receipt.
verdicts.settling_check: Inspect _refusal_receipt to see if meta is cleared; search for where withheld content is stored in meta.

verdicts.strongest_counterargument: All missing symbols are defined in other parts of the same module (not scanned) and are correctly implemented.
verdicts.survives_because: Even if defined elsewhere, the interface is undocumented and changes could break consumers silently.
verdicts.narrowed_claim: External dependencies (session, parse, etc.) are undocumented; changes may cause silent failures.
verdicts.settling_check: Search for definitions of live_egress_seats, check_import_provenance, _Resolver, _collect_module, parse.python_imports; add interface tests.

verdicts.strongest_counterargument: All consumers of resolution_context are verified to always pass the exact scope_key from the index they are using.
verdicts.survives_because: gated_writes.py references variables that may come from a different scope, and it does not appear to use scope_key when accessing the resolver.
verdicts.narrowed_claim: gated_writes.py may use a resolver built under a different scope than its index.
verdicts.settling_check: Trace scope_key usage in gated_writes.py; check if resolution_context is called with a matching key.

verdicts.strongest_counterargument: Markdown link resolution never uses embedding similarity; it resolves links via other means (e.g., file path matching).
verdicts.survives_because: No evidence that markdown link resolution involves embeddings; the hypothesis is speculative.
verdicts.settling_check: Inspect markdown.py:resolve_link to confirm it does not call embedding similarity functions.

verdicts.strongest_counterargument: Full review_packet function contains three distinct statements that nothing was applied.
verdicts.survives_because: The chunk shows only two statements; the third may exist in the full file, but the docstring could be misleading if not.
verdicts.narrowed_claim: The docstring claims three statements but only two are visible in the chunk; full function may have three.
verdicts.settling_check: Retrieve full review_packet function and count 'nothing' statements.

verdicts.strongest_counterargument: Test runner ensures node IDs are unique suffixes (e.g., fully qualified paths), preventing collisions.
verdicts.survives_because: If not guaranteed, endswith can cause false matches for nodes sharing suffix.
verdicts.narrowed_claim: If node IDs are not guaranteed unique suffixes, _same_node may incorrectly match nodes sharing a suffix.
verdicts.settling_check: Check test framework's node ID generation for uniqueness and suffix patterns.

verdicts.strongest_counterargument: Ambigous dotted names are resolved by preferring one candidate (e.g., __init__.py over .py) or picker does not depend on type edges for all modules.
verdicts.survives_because: Even if preference is applied, the exclusion of ambiguous names could miss types; picker may rely on those edges.
verdicts.narrowed_claim: Modules with ambiguous dotted names are excluded from type resolution, potentially missing type edges used by picker.
verdicts.settling_check: Check if picker.py's hotspot_candidates uses type edges from modules with ambiguous names; test with a known ambiguous package.

verdicts.strongest_counterargument: All code paths that handle task content check focus_withheld before any network egress, and lane_for_host is called before any transmission of task data.
verdicts.survives_because: The hypothesis is speculative; no evidence that other paths ignore focus_withheld. The baseline skip is just for snapshot; other paths may enforce the policy.
verdicts.settling_check: Audit all task content transmission paths to verify focus_withheld is checked before egress.
